title: Customer onboarding drop-off
frame: A business scheduling product has many new accounts but fewer first published schedules than expected. Interviews from eight customers mention confusing setup, missing team information and postponement until the next roster cycle. Event logs record account creation, invitations, draft saves and publication, but do not capture offline preparation. The product team has one small release slot this month and needs a plan for deciding what to change and how to learn whether it helps.
